gloss: The inner tip of the ear-canal cartilage; a traditional but mobile guide to the nerve.
role: The cartilage of the ear canal also points toward the nerve, but it moves and is a less exact guide.
matters: The tragal pointer is often taught as 1 cm inferior and 1 cm deep to the trunk; measured distances disagree. The pointer is cartilaginous, mobile and has an irregular tip, and in one prospective series of 79 parotidectomies the distance was significantly less than 1 cm.
